Will You Marry Me Hamburger
By: Cresent
Published: Saturday, December 26, 2009 - 11:53pm

Ingredients




2 pounds ground beef
1/2 pound ground pork
1 env. dry onion soup mix
2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce
2 cups herb season stuffed mix
1 1/2 cups tomato juice
Bacon

Preparation

1 Combine all except bacon; shape with hamburger press, wrap bacon around and fasten with toothpick. Grill 3 inches from flame, approximately 10 minutes each side. While cooking, baste with hot steak sauce. 1/4 c. onion 2 tbsp. Worcestershire sauce 3 tbsp. catsup 1/4 tsp. dry mustard 1/2 tsp. salt 2 Combine to boil on stove and baste.
